AssetKindDto.description:
`AssetKind` on the wire.

Known values: `image`, `video`, `file`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

CartPaymentMethodResponse.description: A payment method as a storefront lists it for a cart.

instructions.description: Shown with the choice and after checkout; `null` for none.

provider.description:
`manual` or an app's key: what the storefront shows after choosing (instructions,
or the app's widget).

items.description: Enabled, offered in the cart's market and channel, in the order to show them.

amount.description: What it collects: the cart's total.

oneOf.description:
The provider's card form (`client_widget`: mount its element with these props on
the checkout, and check out on its `hypha:payment-confirmed`) or page
(`redirect`). `null` when the provider couldn't start (`payment_error`).

payment.description: The payment (`pay_…`): what the provider's reports name.

oneOf.description:
Why the provider couldn't start (an app that's down: `app_unavailable`): start
again. `null` otherwise.

currency.description: The currency of every amount in the cart.

oneOf.description: Who to contact about the order; required at checkout.

fully_available.description: False when any line is unavailable; checkout should refuse such a cart.

market.description: Picked from the country when the cart was created; it sets the currency.

marketing_opt_in.description:
Whether the buyer ticked "Email me with news and offers" (`PUT …/marketing`):
checkout records the consent then (design note 0032, §5).

oneOf.description: The order this cart was checked out as; `null` while it can still change.

How the buyer chose to pay (`PUT …/payment-method`); checkout requires one when
there's something to pay.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller (design note 0029, AP10): an API key or
app without the matching `customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the
object then, whatever the schema says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

oneOf.description: Where it ships: in the cart's country. Required at checkout when something ships.

shipping_groups.description:
The groups of lines that ship together, each needing a chosen option before
checkout; empty when nothing ships.

shipping_ready.description: Whether every group has an option priced now (checkout requires it).

shipping_total.description: The chosen shipping, priced now; zero until chosen. Part of `total`.

subtotal.description: Sum of the available lines, as priced. All totals count available lines only.

tax_total.description:
Tax on the available lines and on shipping: part of `subtotal` and
`shipping_total` if `taxes_included`, else on top.

taxes_included.description: Whether line prices include tax (set on the market).

CategoryRef.description: A category next to it in the tree: an ancestor or a child.

oneOf.description:
The total the buyer saw; if the cart now costs something else, checkout fails
with `total_changed` (409) instead of placing a different order.

return_url.description:
Where a payment provider's page sends the buyer back (a redirect), passed to the
payment's app.

oneOf.description:
For cash on delivery and bank transfer, the instructions (quote the order number
as the reference). `null` when there was nothing to pay, for a payment made
online (before the order), or when a manual provider couldn't start
(`payment_error` says why).
Why a manual method's payment couldn't start. `null` otherwise.

CheckoutResponse.description: What checkout answers: the placed order and what the shopper must do next to pay.

country.description: Where the cart ships to; picks the market and the tax rates.

Currency.description: An ISO 4217 currency code. Funds, precious metals and test codes (XDR, XAU, XXX) aren't accepted.

CustomFieldChoice.description:
A `choice` field's choice: the key is what's stored, filtered and faceted (it can't
change); the label is for people.

ElementExtension.description: A web component an app adds to a storefront (`docs/apps/elements.md`).

module.description:
The ES module that defines it: an absolute URL (`https://`, or `http://localhost`
in development). List its origin in the storefront's `script-src`.

Email.description: An email address; stored trimmed and lowercased, so responses show it that way.

Error.description:
Every error body, for the OpenAPI documents (design note 0010, S9). `ApiError`
serializes as this shape.

code.description: Stable snake_case code: what clients match on.

details.description: Data a client acts on, for the codes that have any (see each operation).

key.description:
As `filter` takes it: `option.color`, `vendor`, `product_type`, `tag`, or
`field.<namespace>.<key>` for a custom field (`field.custom.material`).

label.description: The merchant's label, if they set one.

values.description: Most results first, then by value; at most 100.

count.description: Results (as grouped) with this value, ignoring this facet's own filter.

label.description:
What to show for it: a `choice` field's label, "Yes" or "No" for a `boolean` field
(design note 0033, §9); `null` for every other facet, whose value is its own label.

value.description:
As `filter` takes it: a `choice` field's value is its key, a `boolean` field's
`true` or `false`.

FinancialStatusDto.description:
`FinancialStatus` on the wire. A DTO of its own, so the domain enum carries no
serde and renaming a variant can't silently change the API.
Derived from the order's payments (design note 0027, PA7): manual payments use
`pending`, `paid` and `voided`; the rest come with providers that move money so.

Known values: `pending`, `authorized`, `partially_paid`, `paid`, `partially_refunded`, `refunded`, `voided`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

FulfillmentStatusDto.description:
`FulfillmentStatus` on the wire.

Known values: `unfulfilled`, `partially_fulfilled`, `fulfilled`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

offers.description: What the buyer can pick, in the store's order, priced now.

unavailable.description:
Options of the zone not offered right now, and why: for diagnostics, never shown
as choices.

Language.description: A BCP 47 language tag: a language, then optionally a script, region and variants (`en`, `en-GB`, `sr-Latn`). Responses show it in canonical case.

available_quantity.description:
How many of the variant can be bought now, so a quantity input can stop there:
`null` when there's no limit (stock isn't tracked, or it sells past zero).

handle.description:
The product's handle, to link to its page; `null` when the product is gone or the
cart is checked out.

oneOf.description:
The variant's image, else the product's first media item; `null` without one,
once checked out, or where the deployment has no file storage.

product_title.description:
The product's title now; `null` only when the product or variant is gone, so an
unavailable line still says what it was.

variant_title.description: The variant's option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

oneOf.description: `null` when the cart's country has no tax rates.

Money.description: An amount of money in one currency.

amount.description: In minor units (1050 is 10.50). At most 2^53 - 1 either way, so every amount is exact in JSON.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 currency code. Funds, precious metals and test codes (XDR, XAU, XXX) aren't accepted.

NextActionResponse.description: What the shopper must do next to pay (design note 0027, §3; 0029, §7).

oneOf.description:
Nothing online: show the instructions (cash on delivery, bank transfer). Empty
when the method has none.

Mount the payment app's storefront element (a custom element, loaded from
`GET /storefront/app-extensions?target=checkout.payment`) with these properties
(a card form's client secret), and wait for its `hypha:payment-confirmed` event.
Send the shopper to the provider's page.

amount.description: Before tax if the market's prices exclude it.

fulfilled_quantity.description: How many of `quantity` standing fulfilments shipped.

oneOf.description:
The line's picture as its product is now (an order keeps none): the variant's
image, else the product's first media item; `null` for a product gone or without
media, or without file storage.
`null` when the country had no tax rates.

variant_title.description: The variant's option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

channel.description: The sales channel it was placed through (design note 0020).

created_at.description: When it was created, RFC 3339 in UTC.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller (design note 0029, AP10): an API key or
app without the matching `customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the
object then, whatever the schema says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

oneOf.description: `null` when nothing in the order ships.

shipping_lines.description: How each group of lines ships, as charged.

shipping_total.description: What shipping was charged, as part of `total`.

tax_total.description:
Tax on lines and shipping: part of `subtotal` and `shipping_total` if
`taxes_included`, else on top.

taxes_included.description: Whether line prices include tax (the market decided, at checkout).

updated_at.description: When it last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

oneOf.description: As estimated at checkout.
`null` when the country had no tax rates.
The class whose rate applied; `null` for the country's default rate.

OwnerTypeDto.description:
The kinds of record fields belong to.

Known values: `product`, `variant`, `category`, `customer`, `order`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

PaymentStatusDto.description:
`PaymentStatus` on the wire (design note 0027, PA7).

Known values: `pending`, `authorized`, `processing`, `paid`, `failed`, `voided`, `partially_refunded`, `refunded`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

access_token.description:
Lets whoever holds it read this order: keep it with the buyer (a cookie, the
confirmation email's link), never in a public place. The same for every read.

oneOf.description:
How the buyer pays (design note 0027): the order's newest payment; `null` when
there was nothing to pay.

PlacedOrderResponse.description:
A storefront's view of an order it placed: the order with its access token, the key
to reading it again (`GET /storefront/orders/{id}?token=`; design note 0024, §7).

PlacedPaymentResponse.description:
What a storefront shows of an order's payment: how the shopper chose to pay, where
it is, and what they were told to do.

instructions.description: What the shopper was told at checkout (bank details); `null` for none.

method_name.description:
The method's name when the order was placed; `null` for a payment staff
recorded on an order placed without one.

PostalAddressRequest.description:
Sent: checked by `Address::new` (last name, first line and city required; text is
trimmed, at most 255 characters per field).

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller (design note 0029, AP10): an API key or
app without the matching `customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the
object then, whatever the schema says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

ProductMediaResponse.description:
One item of a product's media list (design note 0014, section 7): what a page needs
to render it. The asset's own route has the rest.

kind.description:
`image` or `video` today. More kinds (3D models) will come: show the ones you
know and skip the others.

thumbnail_url.description:
Images: a version at most 400 pixels wide when the media URLs can resize, else
the original. `null` for videos.

url.description:
The file. Public, so it doesn't expire when served from the media URL; without
one (local development) it is signed and works for `media.download_expires` (15
minutes by default).

ProxyExtension.description: An app with a storefront proxy (`/storefront/apps/{app}/proxy/…`).

SearchHitResponse.description:
One result: a listing, a product or a variant (the request's `group`), shown by
its best match.

available.description: Whether the variant shown can be sold now.

oneOf.description: The variant's image, else the product's featured one.

listing.description: The listing it belongs to: the product, split by the merchant's options.

matched_variants.description: How many of the group's variants matched.

product_price.description: Over the product's variants in this market.

variant.description: The variant shown: the best match of its group.

variant_title.description: "M / Blue"; `null` for a product without options.

max.description: Equal to `min` when every price is the same.

facets.description: The facets the merchant shows (or the defaults), counted over these results.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last. Opaque.

oneOf.description:
The lowest and highest price among the results, ignoring `price_min` and
`price_max` (for a price slider); `null` when nothing matches.

quote_expires_at.description:
RFC 3339: for a provider's rate, when checkout asks the provider again (and may
answer `total_changed`). `null` for built-in rates, which are always current.

oneOf.description: `null` when the cart's country has no tax rates.

opt_in.description: Whether the buyer wants news and offers by email.

oneOf.description:
One of the cart's `payment-methods`; `null` clears the choice. Required, `null`
included: `{}` is `422 invalid_body`, not a quiet clear.

quantity.description: At least 1; `DELETE` the line to take it out.

oneOf.description: In the cart's country; `null` clears it. A new address drops the chosen shipping.

id.description: Stable for the cart: what `PUT …/shipping/{group_id}` names.

lines.description: The available lines that ship in this group.

problem.description:
Why the chosen option can't be charged now; pick again from the offers.
`shipping_option_unavailable`, `no_price_in_currency`, `weight_unknown`, or a money
error code.

oneOf.description: The buyer's choice at its price now; `null` until chosen, or when `problem` is set.

The total the shopper sees; if the cart now costs something else, `409
total_changed` instead of collecting a different amount.

return_url.description:
Where a payment provider's page sends the shopper back (a redirect): a page that
checks the cart out (`POST /storefront/carts/{id}/checkout`).

StorefrontCategoryNode.description: A category in the storefront's tree, with its shown children.

StorefrontCategoryResponse.description: A category page's category: no admin fields, only shown children.

custom_fields.description:
The custom field values the merchant shows storefronts (`access.storefront:
read`, design note 0033).

items.description:
The shown top-level categories, each with its shown children, in order. A hidden
category is left out with everything under it.
Sorted by country code: every country some market sells to.

StorefrontCountryResponse.description: A country a market sells to, with what a storefront needs to show prices there.

minor_units.description: Digits after the decimal point of the currency (2 for EUR, 0 for JPY).

name.description: The English name; UIs show local names (`Intl.DisplayNames`).

StorefrontCustomFieldDefinitionResponse.description:
A field a storefront reads values of: what to call it, where it goes and how to show
its values (design note 0033, §6.2). Values arrive on products', variants' and
categories' `custom_fields`, keyed by `field`.

choices.description:
A `choice` field's (or list of choices') labels, by the key values hold; `null`
for other types.

position.description: On its owner type's form, from 0: the merchant's order.

proxies.description: The apps a storefront may call through the app proxy.

StorefrontProductResponse.description:
A product as a storefront sees it (design note 0010, S5): active products only, without
admin fields. A draft or archived product is `404 product_not_found`, the same as one
that doesn't exist, so a storefront can't tell them apart.

Prices and stock are the shopper's: with `country`, each variant carries its price
in that country's market and whether it can be bought now (design note 0021, SU7),
priced as a cart prices it. Without `country`, there are none: a product's base price
isn't what any shopper pays.

oneOf.description: The currency of the prices; `null` when there are none.

custom_fields.description:
The custom field values the merchant shows storefronts (`access.storefront:
read`, design note 0033), `{"custom.material": "wool", …}`.

description.description: Sanitised HTML (scripts, styles and event attributes removed), safe to render.

media.description: In order; the first is the featured item.

options.description: What a shopper picks a variant by, in order.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether the prices include tax (the market's rule); `null` when there are none.

sold_in_country.description:
Whether `country`'s market sells the product; `null` without `country`. A
product not sold there has no prices: show it as unavailable in the country.

StorefrontStoreResponse.description:
What a storefront sees of the store (design note 0021, SU4): what a header, footer
or contact page shows. Legal details stay in the admin until a storefront needs them.

default_language.description: The language the store's content is written in.

StorefrontTarget.description:
A storefront target (design note 0029, §5).

Known values: `checkout.payment`, `product.block`, `cart.block`, `order.confirmation`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

available.description:
Whether one can be bought now (in stock, or stock isn't tracked); `null` where
there's no price.

available_quantity.description:
How many can be bought now: the stock left in the market's locations, or `null`
when there's no limit (stock isn't tracked, or it sells past zero). `0` where
there's no price.

custom_fields.description: The variant's own custom field values storefronts are shown.

oneOf.description: The item of the product's `media` this variant shows (an image), if any.
In `country`'s market; `null` without `country` or where it isn't sold.

selections.description: One value per option, in the order of `options`.

title.description: Its option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

oneOf.description: The class whose rate applied; `null` for the country's default rate.

TaxRate.description: A tax rate in parts per million: 250000 is 25 %.

reason.description:
`no_price_in_currency`, `weight_unknown`, `provider_failed`, `service_not_quoted`,
or `backup_not_needed` (a backup while a regular option is offered).

publishable_key.description: A publishable API key (`hypha_pk_…`); `Authorization: Bearer` works too.

post.summary:
Places the order for the cart. Takes an `Idempotency-Key` header: a retry returns
the order the first request placed. The body is `{}` or `{"expected_total": …}`.
Something to pay needs a payment method chosen (`PUT …/payment-method`; 409
`payment_method_required`) and still offered (409 `payment_method_unavailable`). An
online method's money must be committed first (design note 0031: `POST
…/payment`): none started is 409 `payment_required`, not yet committed `payment_pending`
(its provider was asked; try again shortly, or it completes when the provider
reports), declined or released `payment_failed` (start paying again). If the order
can't be placed once the money is committed (a line sold out meanwhile), the money is
given back. A cart checked out already answers with its order for an hour after it
was placed (the provider's report may have completed it), then `409 cart_completed`.

post.summary:
Starts paying for the cart before its order exists (design note 0031): an online
method's money is committed first, and checkout places the order once it is. Runs
checkout's checks (409 `total_changed`, `payment_method_required`, …). A pending
payment of the same method and total is started again (the provider resumes it);
otherwise a new one is made and the old ones released. Refused for a manual method
(409 `payment_method_offline`: check out instead), a total of zero (409
`cart_nothing_to_pay`) and a cart whose money is committed already (409
`cart_payment_committed`: check out).

Searches the products the shopper's market sells, priced and stocked there; without
`q`, the market's product listing. Pages go at most 1,000 results deep. With a search
app set (`search_app` in the settings), the app chooses and orders the results
(`search.query`, design note 0029) and Hypha shows its own prices and stock for them;
`price` is then `null`. When the app fails, the built-in engine answers.
